title: Chapter 278
text:
"Huff …"

His heavy breathing was like a broken bellows, mixed with the sticky feeling of blood and phlegm climbing up his throat.

Pa! The mask stained with blood fell to the ground. Leaning against the corner of the table, one could see that the room was full of holes and scars of battle. Dozens of corpses were lying on the ground quietly, and the pool of blood was gradually expanding. In the entire central control room, only the leader was still standing. All the executive officers had died under his fist. The expressions of fear were still frozen on their faces, and they were no longer breathing.

The leader spat out a mouthful of blood and took a deep breath. The thick smell of blood in the room irritated his nose. He suddenly coughed violently and only stopped coughing after two whole minutes.

The fierce battle had triggered his internal injuries. In the ambush battle more than a month ago, he had been seriously injured by Han Xiao. He had not had time to rest, and in the end, it became an internal injury.

Every time he felt a faint pain, he could not help but think of Han Xiao. It was all because of Han Xiao that he was in such a situation. Until now, he was still full of hatred, but this intense emotion could not be stirred up anymore. Only emptiness was left.

The leader came in front of the central control panel and adjusted the nuclear launch option. He then took off his gloves and verified his fingerprint, iris, authorization, and passcode. Two keys were inserted into the holes. As long as they were rotated 180 degrees, the launch would be activated. At the last step, his scarred fingers held the keys, but he did not turn them.

The leader leaned against the chair and looked up. His eyes were not focused, as if he was in a daze. No one knew what he was thinking.

Beep, beep, beep.

A small image appeared in the corner of the screen. It was a call request, and the caller was' Zero '.

The leader pressed 'Accept' without any expression. Han Xiao's face appeared on the screen.

Seeing the corpses all over the floor, Han Xiao raised his eyebrows. He had initiated the call to see the Germinal Organization's attitude and to see the leader for the last time. However, this scene made him understand the situation. He shook his head and said, "Looks like you have already made up your mind."

The leader's eyes were filled with disappointment.

"I didn't think that I would lose to you in the end. You … ant, one wrong step after another. Everything I had was destroyed by you … What do you want to do now? Do you want to confirm your achievements? I'm right here. You can look as you please. My life and the destruction of the Germinal Organization will add a thick stroke to your achievements. You're the winner, so you naturally have the right to admire your spoils of war. "

"I told you, this space is very big. This planet is just a speck of dust. No one in the universe cares about what happens here." Han Xiao shook his head. The great enemy had been dealt with, but his expression was very calm. After all, he was a man who looked at the sea of stars. He slowly said, "I just feel that after doing so many things, I still have to hold it all in before I die. How unbearable."

"You want me to confide in my mortal enemy?" The corners of the leader's mouth twitched, and his ferocious appearance became even more hideous. He lazily leaned back in his chair and relaxed his body. "It is indeed very interesting."

Han Xiao shrugged and went straight to the point. "What's the deal with Destiny's Child?"

The leader laughed loudly and only stopped after a while. He shook his head and said, "Destiny's Child is just a pitiful worm. He can see the future and influence fate, but he can't control his own life and death. He is destined to be a tool in the hands of others … You also have the ability to predict. Maybe Destiny's Child will end up like you!"

Han Xiao did not comment and said, "Tell me about yourself. You seem to be from Gollan?"

The leader's expression changed, and he mumbled, "You found out … Yes, I used to be from Gollan. At that time, I was still a young man, hot-blooded and indignant. At that time, the Mimic incident broke out in our country. I joined the resistance group. I marched, protested, and opposed. I wanted to save my country from a corrupt government."

However, the war suddenly broke out. Raylan invaded. Under internal and external threats, my country was crushed. Everyone died … "The leader suddenly gritted his teeth." Did you hear that? We were called 'internal troubles'! Did I do wrong? Was resistance wrong? No! Our original intention was to fight for the rights that we deserved! All for the sake of making the motherland better!

We were infinitely close to victory, and the dawn was right in front of us, but the war ruined everything. Golan was destroyed, and all my friends were executed. The best way to deal with such disobedient people was to eliminate them. The surviving citizens of Golan were like castrated livestock. They had no choice but to become docile and easier to control. Only a very few managed to escape, and I was one of them.

I was not a big shot. I was just an ordinary young man who did not know where I should go. I was like a walking corpse until I saw the border of Gollan being blocked by Raylan. The national flag that I was familiar with was burned and replaced by the national flag of Raylan. It was then that I woke up, and I knew what kind of mission I had to carry.

Although Gollan was not perfect and had many flaws and darkness, it was still my country. The hatred of my country's destruction could only be …

An eye for an eye, a tooth for a tooth! "

The leader exhaled deeply. His eyes drifted away, and the images of the past appeared before his eyes.

"However, in the current of time, a normal young man was nothing more than a duckweed, and his life was as fragile as an ant's. To pass through the war zone, I dragged my tired body from refugee camp after refugee camp. I was treated like a dog, numbly enduring a life without dignity, but my blood burned. No matter what kind of danger it was, I told myself to live on. Hatred filled my heart, and it never stopped beating … In the end, I successfully passed through the place where the battle was the fiercest. Without stopping or seeking shelter, I turned and headed for the wilderness.

I knew that without power, there was no need to talk about revenge. Therefore, I survived in the wilderness and fought with the beasts. I treated myself as a piece of iron and trained myself. "

At this point, the leader pointed at the scars on his face and hands and said casually, "One hundred and seventy-six scars, and I exchanged them for power."

Han Xiao raised his eyebrows. "So, you are really just a normal person?"

"Why can't I be a normal person?" the leader asked.

After thinking about it, Han Xiao nodded and signaled for the leader to continue his performance.

The leader continued, "When I was in the wilderness, I kept thinking. When I returned to the battlefield, I heard that Mimic still existed. How ironic. A tool created for the rule of terror became the purest surviving Golan force. Therefore, a plan appeared in my mind. I assassinated the leader of Mimic and changed the name of the organization to Germinal. I hid and quietly developed. I also put on a mask.

War is full of opportunities. Countless people lost their countries and became homeless. Therefore, I decided on the concept of Germinal and painted a pie in the sky for them to create a so-called new world … Ideals have always been able to drive the Resonators. It was not that I used the people of the fallen country, but they were willing to be used by me. This was hatred. They did not even care if they could achieve their goal after sacrificing themselves.

By raising my personal desire to the desire of a group, I could gain a lot of help. Germinal absorbed the nutrients of war and grew quickly into a towering tree, a giant monster. "

The leader's tone was full of hatred, but he also felt a sense of loss. The cause that he had been working so hard for had been destroyed. Other than anger, his feelings were extremely complicated.

"Then … you appeared."
